project.author: WarpForge Examples
project.description:
Real-feeling app showcasing scratch_looks_set_text_with_font + scratch_looks_set_text_size_to. Two sprites are 'live labels' — the big headline panel paints the value of `message` in `style_font` at `headline_size` pixels, the signature panel paints `signer` in `sig_font` at its auto-derived size. All three updates flow every frame through a forever loop chaining set-text-with-font → set-text-size-to.

Five buttons drive the variables:
  • Blue pencil — ask for a new headline message (ask_and_wait).
  • Orange pen — ask for a sign-off line.
  • Purple Aa — cycle through four matched font themes.
  • Green A↑ — grow the headline (+4 px, capped at 120).
  • Red A↓ — shrink the headline (−4 px, floored at 12).

Demonstrates the full dynamic-typography pipeline: forever + set-text-with-font + set-text-size-to with all three inputs sourced from variables.
